title: mentha gentilis var. elliptica
intro: Mentha gentilis var. elliptica, commonly known as Peucedanum or Wild Parsley, is a plant species that belongs to the carrot family. It has been used for its medicinal and culinary properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum include antispasmodic, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a potential treatment for coughs, colds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
